title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"   
subtitle: "Post-COVID-19 period (2023–2024): Fig.2, Supplementary Figs.S12 and S13" 
output: html_document
---

If necessary, we can clear the environment to start with a clean workspace.
```{r chunk1}
rm(list=ls())
```

Load packages.
```{r packages, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source("01_load_package.R")
library('ggbeeswarm')
```

Set the drawing theme.
```{r chunk2}
source("02_plot_theme.R")
out_path1 <- "02_output/Fig2_postcovid"
dir.create(out_path1)
```


## Prepare and save CCM data for subsequent analyses
```{r eval=FALSE}
if (FALSE) {
# Load and merge country-level CCM results
path <- "02_output/02_CCM/02_single_CCM/01_single_CCM_country_result"
file_list <- list.files(path = path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

ccm_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(file) {
  read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))


## Set negative cross-mapping skill values to zero
ccm_all[ccm_all$rho_surr<0,"rho_surr"] <- 0
ccm_all[ccm_all$rho_actual<0,"rho_actual"] <- 0

# Retain data required for significance analysis and plotting
ccm_all <- ccm_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(method %in% c("Seasonal", "Ebisuzaki")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    country, RVI_type, RVI_type1,
    rho_actual, rho_surr,
    Kendall_tau, Kendall_p,
    p_sign, method
  )

# Save processed CCM data
saveRDS(
  ccm_all,
  file.path("02_output/CCM_postCOVID_plot_input.rds"),
  compress = "xz"
)
}
```


## Load precomputed CCM results
```{r}
# Load saved CCM results to avoid time-consuming reanalysis
ccm_all <- readRDS("02_output/CCM_postCOVID_plot_input.rds")
```


## Calculate CCM significance using surrogate tests
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(poolr);

climate_vars <- unique(ccm_all$RVI_type)
ccm_all1 <- ccm_all%>% 
  filter(RVI_type %in% climate_vars)
ccm_obs <- ccm_all1[,c("country","RVI_type","rho_actual","Kendall_tau","Kendall_p")]
ccm_obs <- ccm_obs %>%
    distinct() 
ccm_sea <- subset(ccm_all1, method == "Seasonal")
ccm_ebi <- subset(ccm_all1, method == "Ebisuzaki")
ccm_ran <- subset(ccm_all1, method == "Random")

t.p_sea_df <- data.frame()
t.p_ebi_df <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(climate_vars)) {

  obs_RVI <- subset(ccm_obs, RVI_type == climate_vars[i])
  sea_RVI <- subset(ccm_sea, RVI_type == climate_vars[i])
  ebi_RVI <- subset(ccm_ebi, RVI_type == climate_vars[i])

  country_vars <- unique(obs_RVI$country)

  for (j in 1:length(country_vars)) {
    obs <- subset(obs_RVI,  country == country_vars[j])
    sea <- subset(sea_RVI,  country == country_vars[j])
    ebi <- subset(ebi_RVI,  country == country_vars[j])
    
    t.p_obs.sea <- t.test(sea$rho_surr, mu = obs$rho_actual, alternative = "less")[["p.value"]]
    t.p_obs.ebi <- t.test(ebi$rho_surr, mu = obs$rho_actual, alternative = "less")[["p.value"]]
    ccm_obs$t.p_sea[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i] & ccm_obs$country == country_vars[j]] <- t.p_obs.sea
    ccm_obs$t.p_ebi[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i] & ccm_obs$country == country_vars[j]] <- t.p_obs.ebi
  }
  
  # If Kendall's tau is negative or observed CCM skill is non-positive, set the p-value to 1
  ccm_obs[ccm_obs$Kendall_tau<0|ccm_obs$rho_actual<=0,"t.p_sea"] <- 1
  ccm_obs[ccm_obs$Kendall_tau<0|ccm_obs$rho_actual<=0,"t.p_ebi"] <- 1

  t.p_sea <-  ccm_obs$t.p_sea[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]]
  t.p_ebi <-  ccm_obs$t.p_ebi[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]]
  
  t.p<-c(t.p_sea ,t.p_ebi) 

  # Bonferroni correction
  t.p_bonferroni<-p.adjust(t.p,method="bonferroni")
  
  t.p_sea_bonferroni <-t.p_bonferroni[1:length(t.p_sea)]
  t.p_ebi_bonferroni <-t.p_bonferroni[c(length(t.p_sea)+1):c(length(t.p_sea)*2)]
  ccm_obs$t.p_sea_bonferroni[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]] <-t.p_sea_bonferroni
  ccm_obs$t.p_ebi_bonferroni[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]] <-t.p_ebi_bonferroni
  
  t.p_sea_df_rvi <- cbind(data.frame(t.p_sea_bonferroni),ccm_obs$RVI_type[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]])
  t.p_ebi_df_rvi <- cbind(data.frame(t.p_ebi_bonferroni),ccm_obs$RVI_type[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]])
  colnames(t.p_sea_df_rvi)[2] <- "RVI_type"
  colnames(t.p_ebi_df_rvi)[2] <- "RVI_type"

  t.p_sea_df <- rbind(t.p_sea_df,t.p_sea_df_rvi)
  t.p_ebi_df <- rbind(t.p_ebi_df,t.p_ebi_df_rvi)
  
  # Combine Bonferroni-adjusted country-level p-values using Fisher's method
  fisher_t.p_sea <- as.numeric(fisher(t.p_sea_bonferroni)[1])#全球
  fisher_t.p_ebi <- as.numeric(fisher(t.p_ebi_bonferroni)[1])#全球

  ccm_obs$fisher_t.p_sea[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]] <- fisher_t.p_sea
  ccm_obs$fisher_t.p_ebi[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]] <- fisher_t.p_ebi
  
}
```


## Summarize CCM significance across countries
```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
count_t.p_sea <- vector("numeric", length(climate_vars))
count_t.p_ebi <- vector("numeric", length(climate_vars))
fisher_t.p_sea <- vector("numeric", length(climate_vars))
fisher_t.p_ebi <- vector("numeric", length(climate_vars))

count_t.p_sea[] <- NA
count_t.p_ebi[] <- NA
fisher_t.p_sea[] <- NA
fisher_t.p_ebi[] <- NA

for (i in 1:length(climate_vars)) {
  t.p_sea <- t.p_sea_df$t.p_sea_bonferroni[t.p_sea_df$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]]
  t.p_ebi <- t.p_ebi_df$t.p_ebi_bonferroni[t.p_ebi_df$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]]
 
  count_t.p_sea[i] <- sum(t.p_sea < 0.05)
  count_t.p_ebi[i] <- sum(t.p_ebi < 0.05) 
 
  fisher_t.p_sea[i] <- ccm_obs$fisher_t.p_sea[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]][1]
  fisher_t.p_ebi[i] <- ccm_obs$fisher_t.p_ebi[ccm_obs$RVI_type == climate_vars[i]][1]

}

count.p <- data.frame(
  climate_var = climate_vars,
  count_t.p_sea,
  count_t.p_ebi,
  fisher_t.p_sea,
  fisher_t.p_ebi
 
)

```


## Classify CCM significance based on adjusted p-values
```{r}
dat_ccm <- ccm_all[,c("country", "RVI_type" ,"rho_actual","rho_surr","Kendall_tau", "Kendall_p" ,"p_sign", "method", "RVI_type1")]
dat_ccm_obs <- merge(dat_ccm,ccm_obs,by=c("country","RVI_type","rho_actual","Kendall_tau","Kendall_p"),all.x = T)

dat_ccm_obs_ebi = subset(dat_ccm_obs ,dat_ccm_obs$method=="Ebisuzaki")
dat_ccm_obs_ebi$p_sign1 <- NULL
dat_ccm_obs_ebi[dat_ccm_obs_ebi$t.p_ebi_bonferroni<=0.05,"p_sign1"] <- 0
dat_ccm_obs_ebi[dat_ccm_obs_ebi$t.p_ebi_bonferroni>0.05,"p_sign1"] <- 1

dat_ccm_obs_sea = subset(dat_ccm_obs ,dat_ccm_obs$method=="Seasonal")
dat_ccm_obs_sea$p_sign1 <- NULL
dat_ccm_obs_sea[dat_ccm_obs_sea$t.p_sea_bonferroni<=0.05,"p_sign1"] <- 0
dat_ccm_obs_sea[dat_ccm_obs_sea$t.p_sea_bonferroni>0.05,"p_sign1"] <- 1
```

## Figure 2: Post-COVID-19 (IAV)
```{r,fig.width=7, fig.height=10, dpi=300}
ccm_vero_types <- c("Vaccine drives HMPV","INF_A drives HMPV",
                     "Vaccine drives ADV","INF_A drives ADV",
                     "Vaccine drives RV","INF_A drives RV",
                     "Vaccine drives PIV","INF_A drives PIV",
                     "Vaccine drives RSV","INF_A drives RSV","Vaccine drives INF_A")

plot_ccm_virus_vero <- dat_ccm_obs_ebi[dat_ccm_obs_ebi$RVI_type %in% ccm_vero_types,]
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="INF_A drives RSV"),"RVI_type"] <- "IAV drives RSV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="INF_A drives PIV"),"RVI_type"] <- "IAV drives PIV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="INF_A drives RV"),"RVI_type"] <- "IAV drives RV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="INF_A drives ADV"),"RVI_type"] <- "IAV drives ADV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="INF_A drives HMPV"),"RVI_type"] <- "IAV drives HMPV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="Vaccine drives INF_A"),"RVI_type"] <- "AIVC drives IAV"

plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="Vaccine drives RSV"),"RVI_type"] <- "AIVC drives RSV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="Vaccine drives PIV"),"RVI_type"] <- "AIVC drives PIV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="Vaccine drives RV"),"RVI_type"] <- "AIVC drives RV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="Vaccine drives ADV"),"RVI_type"] <- "AIVC drives ADV"
plot_ccm_virus_vero[which(plot_ccm_virus_vero$RVI_type=="Vaccine drives HMPV"),"RVI_type"] <- "AIVC drives HMPV"

ccm_vero_types1 <- c("AIVC drives HMPV","AIVC drives ADV","AIVC drives RV","AIVC drives PIV","AIVC drives RSV","AIVC drives IAV")

plot_ccm_vero <- subset(plot_ccm_virus_vero, RVI_type %in% ccm_vero_types1)
plot_ccm_vero$RVI_type <- factor(plot_ccm_vero$RVI_type, levels = ccm_vero_types1)


custom_colors <- c("#7570b3","#7570b3","#7570b3","#7570b3","#7570b3","#d55e00")

dat_label <- tibble(xpos=c("AIVC drives ADV","AIVC drives HMPV","AIVC drives IAV",
                            "AIVC drives PIV","AIVC drives RSV","AIVC drives RV"), ypos= rep(-0.35, 6),
                    lab =c(expression(italic(p[meta]) < 0.001), expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001),
                           expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001), expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001),
                           expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001), expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001))) 

plot_ccm_vero1 <- unique(plot_ccm_vero[, c("country", "RVI_type", "rho_actual", "method", 
                                                        "RVI_type1", "fisher_t.p_sea", "fisher_t.p_ebi", "p_sign1")])
pc_vero <- ggplot(data=plot_ccm_vero1, aes(x=RVI_type, y=rho_actual,fill=RVI_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(notch=F, outlier.shape = NA,outlier.size = 1,outlier.fill = "black",
               color="black",width=0.6,alpha=0.6)+ 
  geom_quasirandom(data=plot_ccm_vero1,size=4,stroke = 1, width=0.25,  alpha=0.8,
                   aes(x=RVI_type, y=rho_actual, shape=as.factor(p_sign1))) +
  labs(title = "",x="",y=expression(paste("Cross mapping skill (",rho,")"))) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.6, 1),
                     breaks = seq(-0.5, 1,0.5)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black",size=1) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = '',values = c(16, 1),label=c("p < 0.05","p > 0.05")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = '', values = custom_colors) +  
  scale_color_manual(name = '', values = custom_colors) +  
  mytheme+
  geom_text(data = dat_label,
            aes(x = xpos, y = ypos, label = lab), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, parse = TRUE, color = 'gray20', size = 6,
            vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, position = "nudge") +
  coord_flip()+
  guides(color = "none",fill = "none") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),panel.grid.major.y=element_blank())

pc_vero
ggsave(pc_vero ,filename = file.path(paste0(out_path1,"/Fig2A_Ebisuzaki_postcovid_vero.pdf")),
         width = 7.5,height=6.1,device   = cairo_pdf,  family   = "Arial") 

ccm_virus_types1 <- c("IAV drives HMPV", "IAV drives ADV","IAV drives RV", "IAV drives PIV", "IAV drives RSV")

plot_ccm_virus$RVI_type <- factor(plot_ccm_virus$RVI_type, levels = ccm_virus_types1)

custom_colors <- c("#4daf4a","#4daf4a","#4daf4a","#4daf4a", "#4daf4a")

dat_label <- tibble(xpos=c("IAV drives ADV","IAV drives HMPV","IAV drives PIV",
                           "IAV drives RSV","IAV drives RV"), ypos= rep(-0.35, 5),
                    lab =c(expression(italic(p[meta]) < 0.001), expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001),
                           expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001), expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001),
                           expression(italic(p[meta]) <0.001))) 

plot_ccm_virus1 <- unique(plot_ccm_virus[, c("country", "RVI_type", "rho_actual", "method", 
                                                        "RVI_type1", "fisher_t.p_sea", "fisher_t.p_ebi", "p_sign1")])
pc_virus <- ggplot(data=plot_ccm_virus1, aes(x=RVI_type, y=rho_actual,fill=RVI_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(notch=F, outlier.shape = NA,outlier.size = 1,outlier.fill = "black",
               color="black",width=0.53,alpha=0.6)+ 
  geom_quasirandom(data=plot_ccm_virus1,size=4,stroke = 1, width=0.25,  alpha=0.8,
                   aes(x=RVI_type, y=rho_actual, shape=as.factor(p_sign1))) +
  labs(title = "",x="",y=expression(paste("Cross mapping skill (",rho,")"))) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.6, 1),
                     breaks = seq(-0.5, 1,0.5)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black",size=1) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = '',values = c(16, 1),label=c("p < 0.05","p > 0.05")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = '', values = custom_colors) +  # Set colors for p < 0.05 and p > 0.05
  scale_color_manual(name = '', values = custom_colors) +  # Set colors for p < 0.05 and p > 0.05
  mytheme+
  geom_text(data = dat_label,
            aes(x = xpos, y = ypos, label = lab), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, parse = TRUE, color = 'gray20', size = 6,
            vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, position = "nudge") +
  coord_flip()+
```
